_instructions: Data used by `npm run seed`. Replace every TODO before your demo.
users: the demo accounts. Change the passwords if the site will be public.
exhibitions: 'key' is only used inside this file to connect artifacts to an exhibition.
artifacts: one entry per model. 'model' is the file name in server/uploads/models (created by npm run models:optimize).
The thumbnail is found automatically: server/uploads/thumbnails/<model name>.webp (created by npm run models:thumbnails).
'exhibition' is an exhibition key or null. Artifacts appear in the guided tour in the order they are listed here.

Optional artifact fields: material, tags (array), hotspots ([{ position: [x, y, z] in the model's own coordinates, title, text }]), cameraPosition ([x, y, z]: the direction the 3D viewer looks from; default [2.5, 1.5, 3]).
quizzes: one per exhibition ('exhibition' = its key). answerIndex is the position of the right option, counting from 0.
